title: Portable V1/V2 Capability Catalog
evidenceBoundary: This is a bounded inventory, not proof that every V1 behavior was discovered: editable V1 source and broad/raw discovery inventories were not retained. It preserves only claims supported by surviving source, documents, tests, or explicit owner decisions. The removed V1 production database, customer records, credentials, sessions, and runtime behavior are not recovered or implied.
